title: Freshers' Welcome: Stars & Stripes Social
description: WELCOME TO AMERICAN STUDIES SOC!! 🇺🇸🎉 Come meet the committee, grab some free hot dogs and root beer, and find out what we've got planned this year. No passport required 😎

title: Debate Night: Is the American Dream Dead?
description: The age-old question 🤔💀 Two teams, one moderator, zero chill. Come argue about whether the American Dream is alive and well or buried under student debt. Pizza provided 🍕

title: Halloween Movie Marathon 🎃
description: IT'S SPOOKY SZN 👻🍿 We're screening three American horror classics back to back. Costumes strongly encouraged, jumpscares guaranteed. Free candy for anyone who makes it through all three without leaving 😈

title: Thanksgiving Dinner 🦃
description: We're doing Thanksgiving PROPER — turkey, mac & cheese, sweet potato pie, the WORKS 🇺🇸🍽️ Tickets selling fast bc we literally cannot fit more people in the room. Veggie options available dw

title: Christmas Film Night: Home Alone
description: KEVIN!! 🏠🎄 It's not Christmas without Home Alone and we will NOT be taking questions on that. Mince pies, hot chocolate, and questionable parenting decisions. Wear your ugliest jumper 🎅

title: Guest Lecture: Civil Rights in the 21st Century
description: We've got a visiting professor from Howard University talking about the legacy of the Civil Rights Movement and where we go from here 📚✊ Genuinely unmissable if you care about this stuff. Q&A after

title: Super Bowl Watch Party 🏈
description: IT'S SUPER BOWL SUNDAYYYY (well Monday at 11pm but whatever) 🏈🇺🇸 We've booked out the back room at BrewDog and there WILL be wings. Even if you don't understand American football just come for the halftime show and the ads 😂

title: American Road Trip Pub Quiz 🚗
description: Route 66, state capitals, obscure presidential trivia — if you know your stuff this is YOUR night 🧠🇺🇸 Teams of 3-6, winner gets a genuinely incredible prize (mystery). Losers buy the next round 🍺

title: The Simpsons Movie Screening + Drinks
description: SIMPSONS MOVIE SCREENING + DRINKS!!!! Spider Pig. Spider Pig. Does whatever a Spider Pig does. Come watch Homer doom an entire town then drown your sorrows at BrewDog. Tuesday 31st March, 6pm SU B1 ➡️ 8pm BrewDog Oxford Rd 🇺🇸🍩🍺

title: End of Year BBQ: American Cookout 🌭
description: WE MADE IT THROUGH THE YEAR 🎓🇺🇸 Celebrating the only way Americans know how — burgers, hot dogs, red solo cups and way too much ketchup. Free for members, £3 for everyone else. Come say bye before summer 🫶
